description: A Laravel app that sends an order-shipped notification by email and SMS through Courier, from a custom Laravel notification channel queued after the transaction commits.
rules: Use the trycourier/courier Composer package and call $client->send->message(message: [...], idempotencyKey: ...). Array keys are camelCase, such as userID and phoneNumber.
Read COURIER_API_KEY through config('services.courier.key') on the server only.
Send from App\Notifications\Channels\CourierChannel. Notifications return it from via() and build the message in toCourier().
Queue the notification with ShouldQueue and $this->afterCommit(), so a rolled-back transaction never notifies.
Pass the notification's id as the idempotency key. Laravel keeps it across queue retries and gives each notify() call a new one.
